about: Permit for Emirati drivers to work as private taxi drivers.
note: Requirements read from the official Abu Dhabi Mobility page on the checked date. This service has no sign-in form of its own to read yet. Translations not reviewed by native speakers.

eligibility: UAE nationals or children of Emirati mothers
Pass the assessment with at least 60% correct and complete five online training courses
Valid UAE driving licence and clean criminal, health and eye test certificates
documents: Coloured passport copy, white-background photo and school certificate showing ten academic years
Initial approval from the relevant authorities and the assessment pass certificate
Emirates ID, original driving licence and a photo in UAE uniform
Birth certificate and valid residence for children of Emirati mothers
fees: No fee is listed for each step; assessment fees are paid when booking and third party certificate costs are not stated
timing: Arrive 30 minutes before the assessment; arriving over 90 minutes late counts as a fail
channels: Customer Happiness Office in Abu Dhabi or Al Ain
